Results.ReviewText: I am very happy with my grill. I have had it a few weeks, at this point, and I have used it 4 or five times already. A steak only takes 6 minutes on each side. The only problem that I have had is regarding lighting up the burners. Once when I tried to set started the grill would not get hot. The instructions stated that we should turn on the gas for 5 minutes before lighting. I did just that, and just before I ignited it I opened the lid, waited a few seconds for the propane to evacuate and then I ignited. There was an explosion and every hair in my right are burned completely off leaving black ash on my arm. I am certain that I did something wrong, I just believe that the instructions need to be more clear regarding getting air out of the gas line. Now I do things differently and I an very happy with the results. One more thing: I bought this grill new in the box, no damage to the box what so ever. There were two pieces which were damaged in the box. One was the H shaped bracket on the bottom half of the unit, 9n the back. Two extensions were bent in, causing difficulty assembling. Also the chrome face under the burner knobs was scratched. Didn't affect the operation of the grill, and I just wanted to complete the assembly which took two and a half hours.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I've had this grill since early summer (2+ months) and have had several occasions to use it for basic grilling of burgers, hot dogs, chicken legs and steaks and have been quite happy with the performance for these ordinary tasks. So far I haven't tried any serious barbeque or roast cooking although I did purchase the Weber iGrill thermometer system at time of original purchase. Unfortunately, the thermometer instructions did not address installation on this model grill even though it is supposed to accept it. The grills referenced in the install guide have mount points that are not present on the legs of this grill for the battery unit and I haven't used it yet for this reason. Hopefully Weber has some more updated info on their website to help address this model.

Another small gripe is that the aluminum drip tray holder is a basic stamped metal item that was shipped with extremely sharp edges! I know this from learning "the hard way" and having to visit an urgent care center after trying to install it to staunch the bleeding. After a few months of use (with the supplied replaceable aluminum insert) I carefully removed the tray holder and found the removable insert stuck inside the holder by grease that had accumulated between the tray and the holder. I decided to thoroughly clean the holder and ran it under hot water in the sink and then used a steel wool cleaning pad to shine it. After cleaning with the pad I continued rubbing the pad against the rough edges and found it smoothed them out very easily and made it much safer to handle. This raises the question of why Weber didn't bother taking the simple step of doing this in the factory prior to shipping it. I guess it may take someone filing a lawsuit to make this happen.

I do like the grill and find the iron grill plates to be a convenient size to clean in my kitchen sink after use. Hopefully I can get the digital thermometer connected properly and will try some slow-cooked barbeques and roasts before the end of the season.
Results.Title: Minor flaws

Results.ReviewText: I've got 4 months on the grill, and by in large it works and cooks my chicken and burgers. The electric start failed and Weber replaced it as expected.. One comment;  I put a rotisserie on it and find the burners are arranged the wrong way.  Not a show stopper but hard to cook anything bigger than a squab - it cooks unevenly since the burners are at right angles to the rotisserie

Results.ReviewText: I’ve used this grill several times and I love it!  I really like the propane tank hanging on the side vs being behind a door under the grill. Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought this in May and within the first two months the grill struggled to ignite and heat up properly. The front part where the controls are for the burners is loose and doesn't seem to be tight to the rest of the grill. Lighting has been very interesting and has made me pretty uncomfortable. It takes a while and by that time the grill is filled with propane and when it sparks it shakes the whole grill. I have had Weber my whole life, but am not sure if I'd buy another.

Results.ReviewText: We purchased this grill about a month ago.  My first time grilling again in over 7 years (long story). This has been one of my better purchases.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I just bought a new Spirit II - 2-burner grill to replace my old one bought 24 years ago.  I’ve only used it once, but it surprised me with how fast it pre-heated and grilled the hamburgers. The one thing that is missing is PROPER hooks to hang my Weber utensils.  The hooks provided are not wide enough, so you have to attach a twist to the handles to utilize each of the three hooks. And I would have liked the shelves on either side to fold down, but that is a minor complaint.

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
